description: This file defines the ResizableDoubleArray class, a dynamic array implementation in Java that automatically expands and contracts its internal storage as elements are added or removed. It provides methods for adding, removing, and accessing elements, as well as managing the internal storage size based on configurable expansion and contraction criteria.

classes.name: ResizableDoubleArray
classes.description: A variable length, automatically expanding and contracting array of doubles. Supports dynamic resizing based on expansion and contraction policies, and provides methods for element manipulation and internal array management.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Appends a double value to the end of the array, expanding internal storage if necessary.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to the end of the array, expanding internal storage to accommodate the new data.

methods.name: addElementRolling
methods.description: Adds a new element at the end of the array, simultaneously removing the first element (rolling), and returning the discarded element.

methods.name: substituteMostRecentElement
methods.description: Replaces the most recently added element with a new value, returning the old value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the array, setting the element count to zero.

methods.name: contract
methods.description: Reduces the internal storage array to exactly hold the current number of elements plus one.

methods.name: discardFrontElements
methods.description: Removes a specified number of elements from the front of the array.

methods.name: discardMostRecentElements
methods.description: Removes a specified number of elements from the end of the array.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the internal storage array based on the expansion mode and factor.

methods.name: expandTo
methods.description: Expands the internal storage array to a specific size.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a specific index.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns a copy of all elements currently stored.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Returns the total size of the internal storage array.

methods.name: getNumElements
methods.description: Returns the number of elements currently stored.

methods.name: setElement
methods.description: Sets the value of an element at a specific index, expanding the array if necessary.

methods.name: setContractionCriteria
methods.description: Sets the contraction criterion, which determines when to shrink internal storage.

methods.name: getExpansionFactor
methods.description: Retrieves the current expansion factor controlling array resizing.

methods.name: getExpansionMode
methods.description: Returns the current expansion mode (multiplicative or additive).
